claim_scope: regression guard for a synthetic local workload; not production capacity or an SLO

rationale.timing: Timing ceilings allow roughly 3x to 5x the measured baseline because shared CI runners differ from the recorded machine; the 165 ms ingestion ceiling is five times the recorded 32.984 ms baseline and catches large regressions rather than normal runner variation.
rationale.dashboard: Asset ceilings allow approximately 15 percent growth over the measured transfer sizes and require deliberate review beyond that point.
